answer_1.quote: We present a general approach to this alignment problem. We demonstrate its value for the evaluation and comparison of LLM-powered dialogue systems, in an information-seeking dialogue task

answer_2.quote: LLM-RUBRIC can be used like other metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, etc.) to drive system development, monitor quality, demonstrate the value of a new technique, and conduct competitions.

answer_3.quote: Our method uses these data to train an automatic LLM-based evaluator, without treating the 24 human annotators as interchangeable.

answer_4.quote: Each user-AI dialogue is evaluated by 3 trained annotators (randomly drawn from a larger pool) who each answered the same 9 rubric questions.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation rubric includes questions on naturalness, citation quality, dialogue efficiency, and overall user satisfaction, with defined response options for each.
